svg.title: A 6-year ginkgo, 8373 commits, 7 lanterns for code reviews.
svg.desc: A bonsai grown from the public GitHub history of maintainer, drawn for 2025-10-08. Drawn as a ginkgo, which is a choice of the owner's. Season: autumn. Maturity level 7 of 13, in a antique pot. Every element is recomputable from public history; nothing here is random or purchasable.
